connector.name: Pulse8 Ai Cortex Knowledge Vault
connector.registryDescription: Agent-native knowledge OS on Markdown: typed graph, hybrid search, and compiler over MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package pulse8-ai-cortex-knowledge-vault. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the synpulse8-opensource account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CORTEX_VAULT_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the Markdown vault directory the server reads and writes.

env.name: CORTEX_LLM_API_KEY
env.description: Optional OpenRouter (or compatible) API key. Only needed for LLM cross-referencing during compile; file conversion and search work without it.
